input.basis: Only the packet was read. Provider/runtime and unchanged-inventory facts are accepted as supplied oracle/check evidence, not independently re-executed by this judge.

scope: Narrow post-fix retest of catalogue-derived 2015/national provenance leakage, with separate answer-quality and goal-completion assessments.

rubric.provenance_regression: Pass: applicable source year/geography and assistant descriptions agree with 2022/city oracle; fail: wrong catalogue-derived metadata is asserted; partial: mixed correct/incorrect provenance; blocked: insufficient context/evidence.
rubric.answer_quality: Pass: requested material explanations agree with packet evidence, with honest limitations; partial: useful grounded answer with an identified factual/presentation defect or unresolved material claim; fail: misleading or unusable response; blocked: no evaluable answer. A pass is bounded by packet coverage and is not a claim of universal factual perfection.
rubric.goal_completion: UC01: prepare a review draft, identify connected sources/category coverage and explain fit checks, without inventory save. UC02: prepare draft and explain I.1.1 origin/year/value/fit/limitations, without inventory save. Pass allows a separately recorded presentation defect when the exact requested value and source explanation are delivered. Consent to prepare the draft is intended behavior. Saving, inventory creation/import, and obtaining unavailable fuel quantities are not required.
rubric.aggregation: Unit is one clean conversation. Six total: UC01-r2/r3/r4 and UC02-r1/r2/r3. Supplemental UC01-r1 excluded. Count pass/partial/fail/blocked per dimension; no weights, percentages, overall numerical score, or per-turn averaging.
